canonical_title: Microsoft plans September unveiling for Maia 300 AI chip
treatment: Official Maia 300 unveiling and hardware specifications now covered as 2026-10-12 FOLLOW_UP. Future mentions need new production availability, independent performance validation, customer adoption, or material design changes.
known_facts: The Information reported Microsoft plans to unveil Maia 300 as early as September 2026.
Microsoft is reportedly discussing TSMC capacity for more than 300,000 units for delivery in 2027, with a longer-term ambition above one million units.
Microsoft is reportedly seeking adoption from major cloud customers including Anthropic.
On 2026-10-12 Microsoft officially unveiled Maia 300, replacing the earlier unconfirmed September unveiling plan.
Microsoft announced 2027 production deployment and multi-gigawatt Azure Maia scale-out; Reuters reported potential deployment above one million Maia 300 chips in 2027.
Microsoft says Maia 300 provides 40% more tokens per megawatt than unspecified leading GPU systems and up to 7x Maia 200 rack-scale throughput; these are vendor claims, not independent benchmarks.
Maia 300 features TSMC N2P compute chiplets, 8 HBM4 stacks with 18 TB/s peak bandwidth, 950 W accelerator TDP, and 96-accelerator racks using 167 kW with 27.6 TB HBM capacity.
Microsoft's Maia 200 is already serving production Copilot workloads, while Maia 300 deployment is not yet live.
reinclude_only_if: Maia 300 enters production in 2027 or actual deployment/availability becomes verifiable.
Independent workload-matched benchmark and pricing/TCO comparisons are published.
Microsoft confirms external customer adoption or material hardware changes.
notes: Reuters report published 2026-08-10 13:09 UTC = 22:09 JST; underlying claims are attributed to The Information and were not confirmed by Microsoft in the Reuters report. 2026-10-12 22:01 JST Reuters official unveiling report; follow-up delta is first-party specifications and concrete deployment plan, not a fresh canonical topic.
